---
title: "Analyzing School Districts and Americans' Time Use"
author: "Javier Mercado"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb")
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_dist |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(district_id, rla_2023 = rla_score),
    by = "district_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()

dbplyr_state <- tbl(con, "state_scores")

state_change <- dbplyr_state |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_state |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(stateabb, rla_2023 = rla_score),
    by = "stateabb"
  ) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()

state_change |>
  arrange(rla_change)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  collect() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Reading Score Changes (2015 to 2023)",
    subtitle = "Across 9,644 school districts with scores in both years",
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA 2025)",
    x = "Change in Reading Score (RLA)",
    y = "Number of Districts"
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
state_change |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = state_name, color = rla_change > 0),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray50", size = 1.5) +
  labs(
    title = "State-Level Changes in Reading Scores (2015 to 2023)",
    subtitle = "States sorted by 2023 score; gray dots indicate 2015 baseline",
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA 2025)",
    x = "Reading Score (RLA)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Improved"
  )
```

```{r}
con_atus <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/atus.duckdb")
dbplyr_act <- tbl(con_atus, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con_atus, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con_atus, "activity_codes")

activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(mean_weekday_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

activity_avg
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = fct_reorder(major_name, mean_weekday_minutes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_weekday_minutes, y = major_name, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Minutes by Activity Category",
    subtitle = "Weekday time use among non-employed respondents, by sex",
    x = "Average Minutes per Day",
    y = "Activity Category",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```

```{r}
hourly_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  mutate(start_hour = start_hhmm %/% 100) |>
  filter(
    major_name %in% c(
      "Personal Care Activities",
      "Eating and Drinking",
      "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure",
      "Sports, Exercise, & Recreation"
    ),
    between(start_hour, 6, 23)
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, start_hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, start_hour, major_name) |>
  summarize(mean_weekday_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = start_hour, y = mean_weekday_minutes, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 6:23,
    labels = sprintf("%02d:00", 6:23)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How Non-Employed Respondents' Days Fill Up",
    subtitle = "Average minutes spent in activities beginning each hour, by sex",
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Average Minutes",
    fill = "Activity Category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```
